history: Amazon Science · Two Decades of Recommender Systems
讀 item-to-item 的離線關聯與線上組合，以及不同推薦位置的需求；歷史文章不能代表目前完整架構。
Read offline item relationships and online aggregation, with different recommendation surfaces. This historical account does not disclose the complete current architecture.
complements: 看互補／替代關係、類型多樣性與方向性；本文相機案例是自行設計。
Study complement/substitute relationships, type diversity, and directionality. The camera example here is an original teaching scenario.
nvidia: NVIDIA · Pro Tips for Building Multilingual Recommender Systems
讀候選生成、session × candidate 資料表與排序特徵。文章介紹 KDD Cup 方法；不等於線上服務效能證據。
Read candidate generation, the session-by-candidate dataframe, and ranking features. The KDD Cup walkthrough is not evidence of online serving performance.
m2: 六個 locale 的匿名 session、商品屬性與官方切分。標的是下一個互動商品，不是完整曝光、購買與退貨紀錄。
Anonymous sessions, product attributes, and official splits across six locales. The target is the next engaged product, not a complete exposure, purchase, and return log.
reviews: 評論、商品 metadata、圖片與時間欄位；評論時間不等於購買時間，metadata 也未必有歷史版本。
Reviews, product metadata, images, and timestamps. Review time is not purchase time, and metadata may lack historical versions.
tfrs: Two-tower、完整候選評估與 ANN 匯出；原教學用 MovieLens，商品任務需改標籤與切分。
Two towers, full-candidate evaluation, and ANN export. The tutorial uses MovieLens; adapt labels and splits for commerce.
tfrs-loss: 已查核 candidate_sampling_probability、candidate_ids、score_mask 與 remove_accidental_hits 的用途；本篇未執行訓練。
Inspected candidate_sampling_probability, candidate_ids, score_mask, and remove_accidental_hits. No training was run for this guide.
sampling: 理解 in-batch negatives 與長尾分布下的抽樣偏差；訓練校正必須對應實際 sampler。
Understand in-batch negatives and sampling bias under a long-tailed distribution. Training correction must match the actual sampler.
din: Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
候選相關的歷史注意力；原始研究來自 Alibaba 廣告場景，不是 Amazon 的公開模型說明。
Candidate-aware attention over history. The original work concerns Alibaba advertising, not a disclosure of Amazon's models.
esmm: 讀曝光→點擊→轉換的條件機率與選擇偏差；不能把多任務學習當作解決所有曝光偏差。
Read conditional probabilities and selection bias along exposure, click, and conversion. Multitask learning does not resolve every exposure bias.
feast: 依歷史時間重建特徵；精確重播線上已知狀態，還要處理遲到與可用時間。
Reconstruct historical features. Exact replay of online knowledge also requires late-arrival and availability-time semantics.
personalize: Amazon Personalize · Use Case and Recipe Features
區分即時行為適應、探索與模型更新；服務功能不能當成完整 Amazon 零售架構。
Separate real-time behavioral adaptation, exploration, and model updates. Service features do not describe the complete Amazon retail architecture.
filters: 了解推薦結果如何受商品與互動條件限制；本文的庫存查驗與補取策略是設計建議。
Understand item and interaction constraints on recommendations. Live availability checks and refill policies in this guide are proposed designs.
sampled-eval: Google Research · On Sampled Metrics for Item Recommendation
抽樣負例可能改變模型優劣排序；區分完整候選、抽樣 benchmark 與 ANN 評估。
Sampled negatives can change relative model rankings. Separate full-candidate, sampled-benchmark, and ANN evaluation.
baselines: Google Research · On the Difficulty of Evaluating Baselines
強 baseline 需要合理調參與一致的評估協定，不能以弱對照製造模型進步。
Strong baselines require reasonable tuning and consistent evaluation protocols; weak controls can manufacture apparent progress.
srm: Microsoft Research · Diagnosing Sample Ratio Mismatch
先排查分流與資料品質，再解讀 lift。本文觀察窗、MDE 與 rollout 設定需由實際資料決定。
Check assignment and data quality before interpreting lift. Observation windows, MDE, and rollout settings require real data.
sar: 追 user affinity、item similarity 與推薦組合；SAR 不等於 Amazon item-to-item 的精確實作。
Trace user affinity, item similarity, and recommendation aggregation. SAR is not an exact implementation of Amazon's item-to-item system.
sasrec: 已查看程式：使用 leave-one-out，num_neg_test = 100。適合學流程，數值不可直接當全商品庫效果。
Code inspected: leave-one-out splitting and num_neg_test = 100. Useful for learning the workflow; metrics are not full-catalog results.
blair: Amazon Reviews 2023 / BLaIR · Processing and Models
讀 benchmark_scripts、blair、seq_rec_results；追溯前處理、商品文字表示與序列推薦重現設定。
Read benchmark_scripts, blair, and seq_rec_results for preprocessing, item text representations, and sequential recommendation experiments.
merlin: 看 session 資料如何進模型；安裝前核對套件與 GPU 相依版本，本篇沒有宣稱可直接重現。
Inspect how session data enters the model. Verify package and GPU dependencies before installation; no reproduction is claimed here.
dsstne: Amazon DSSTNE · Historical Sparse Recommendation Engine
可讀稀疏推薦與多 GPU 設計；已封存，適合歷史工程導讀，不作新實作起點。
Study sparse recommendation and multi-GPU design. Archived; useful historical engineering material, not the starting point for a new implementation.
interview: 參考召回→排序→評估的說明方式；教學方案不代表公司內部架構或特定考題。
Learn how to explain retrieval, ranking, and evaluation. A teaching framework is not evidence of an internal architecture or a particular interview question.
